project.name: Avalon documentary service imagery
project.objective: Replace all twelve service images after user rejected artificial staging, malformed anatomy and fabricated screens.

creative_system.visual_thesis: Candid people, real materials and ordinary working places photographed with natural light.
anti_goals: Coordinated coral/green props and synthetic stock styling
Invented legible interfaces, claims, data or client evidence
creative_system.composition: Photographic 4:3 masters with subjects positioned for responsive crops.
creative_system.lighting: Natural window light or plausible practical lighting.
creative_system.typography: Live HTML captions and service descriptions.
invariants: Illustrative generated scenes, not actual staff or client photographs
Screens oblique, hidden or defocused when exact content would be fabricated

assets.description: Candid medium-wide photograph of one female creative director, about forty, in a charcoal cotton sweater, quietly reviewing three large printed photographs and pencilled notes on a modest oak meeting table. She is seated in side profile, chin resting naturally in one hand, other hand relaxed on the table. A second colleague is softly out of focus across the table, listening, with only their shoulder and notebook visible. Real small design consultancy office with off-white plaster walls and a single north-facing window on an overcast day, worn oak floor, radiator, a chair with a coat draped on it. Soft flat window daylight, natural unretouched skin texture and flyaway hairs. Shot at seated eye level with a 50mm lens, f/4, documentary magazine photograph; intimate concentration rather than a group brainstorming pose. Photograph for a creative agency website. Observational editorial photography, believable ordinary working environment with thoughtful composition. Neutral white balance, gentle realistic contrast, true material textures, subtle sensor grain, imperfect everyday details. Behind-the-scenes editorial photograph in a bright, impeccably clean independent bakery. One female content photographer wearing a plain navy T-shirt stands in the near left foreground in side profile, operating a real compact mirrorless camera with both hands at eye level. At the centre of the frame a Black male baker in a clean cream apron places one freshly baked round sourdough loaf on a simple wooden serving board using both hands. He is setting the finished loaf down, not kneading it, not cutting it. The two adults and their hands are clearly separated, neither looks at the viewer. Clean white glazed subway tiles, tidy stainless-steel bench, one ordinary rack with several finished loaves, warm natural daylight from a large window. No stains, dirt, distressed walls, brand names or readable writing. 35mm documentary photograph at f/4, realistic unretouched skin, flour lightly dusting only the wooden board, natural camera mechanics. Precise real-world composition and material texture; lively craft with no CGI sheen.

Candid editorial portrait photograph of a South Asian female media planner in her late thirties, speaking on a small black office telephone while listening attentively, seated at a clean contemporary oak desk. Frame her at eye level from the desk corner, waist up, face in three-quarter profile. She wears a textured charcoal blazer over a plain light shirt; natural skin texture, stray hairs, focused everyday expression. One closed plain unbranded silver laptop, a closed linen notebook and a pen are on the desk. No open screens, magazines, newspapers, printed writing, charts, logos or data anywhere. Soft overcast window daylight fills a well-maintained small agency office; off-white walls, blurred city window and simple shelving. Real professional editorial photography, subtle grain and restrained contrast, 50mm lens at f/4. A thoughtful media negotiation during a real workday. Main subject near center for responsive crop. No CGI, no glam retouching, no coordinated colorful props.

The camera is behind his left shoulder, showing the back of his head and a slight side profile; he faces directly toward the laptop in front of him, hands naturally resting on its keyboard. Laptop screen faces him and the camera but is deliberately far outside the shallow focus plane, just a softly blurred ordinary light application window with no legible content. No separate monitor and no desktop computer tower. A closed plain linen notebook, pen and one simple dark desk lamp are the only other desk objects. rights_and_claims.description: User explicitly requested all service photographs to be revised. No reference likenesses or client endorsements. Existing website disclosure retained.

review_notes: Original production scene contained disconnected-looking anatomy; the full original set was replaced.
Original artificial charts and screens replaced with human activities and physical craft.
